agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: Diplomatic and industrial attire blending salt-crusted formality with tidal utility. Garments feature verdigris copper plating, heavy salt-white fabrics, and coral-red ceremonial accents to signify rank in the negotiation of extinct river rights.

role_style_rules.silhouette_notes: Stiff, rectangular aprons and high collars.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: High contrast coral-red on dark indigo.
Dark teal and verdigris for camouflage.
role_style_rules.silhouette_notes: Streamlined for movement and wind resistance.

default_rule.palette_notes: Neutral salt-white with minor verdigris trim.

visual_consistency_rules: All sprites must use 1px selective dark indigo outlines.
Coral-red is reserved for high-status seals or critical tools.
Metallic elements must show verdigris (green-teal) oxidation.
Footwear must appear heavy/waterproof (boots or waders).
Maintain 32x32 grid alignment for all held props.

visual_canon.world_prompt_prefix: top-down pixel art, 16-bit, verdigris and salt-white, intertidal embassy, orthographic, grid-aligned
visual_canon.sprite_prompt_prefix: top-down pixel art sprite, 16-bit, diplomatic attire, coral-red accents, orthographic
